searchText: Hello guys! I want to learn solidity and smart contracts, but i don`t like Remix ide. I tried to set up vscode and truffle, and deployed my contract to ganache. How do i access contract methods from ganache CLI? Help me pls Please seek out ganache support. This server is for research and development of Ethereum itself, not all of the stuff built on top of it. oh, sorry, thx How do I get current miner.gasLimit setting from a running geth node? I don't think you can (might be wrong!) but you can set it via JSON RPC to what you'd like it to be: https://geth.ethereum.org/docs/rpc/ns-miner#miner_setGasLimit
